title: Assign the Priority
subtitle: Apply the matrix to the ticket
scenario: It is 2:11 PM. TKT-4001 is classified as an outage. Now score it: checkout down for all users is high impact, and nobody can pay right now is high urgency. Apply the matrix - high plus high is P1 - and record impact and urgency separately so the derivation is auditable.
input: Ticket TKT-4001 (outage): "Checkout is down for all users - nobody can pay." Impact: all users affected -> high. Urgency: revenue-blocking, must move now -> high. Matrix: high impact + high urgency = P1. Record impact, urgency, and the derived priority.
instructions: Set impact and urgency from the ticket (both high here).
Apply the matrix to set the derived priority (P1).
Return one valid JSON object, then validate.
copilotPrompt: Assign priority for TKT-4001: impact high (all users), urgency high (revenue-blocking), so priority P1 by the matrix. Record impact and urgency separately.
successMessage: Priority assigned: P1. You derived it from impact and urgency, not tone.
editorHelper: Record the inputs and the derived priority.

sections.title: Two inputs, one output
sections.body: You do not pick a priority - you compute it. Read the ticket for impact and urgency, then look up the cell. Recording both inputs is what makes the P1 defensible.

sections.title: This one is a real P1
sections.body: Checkout down for all users is high impact; revenue blocked now is high urgency. Both high means P1 - the matrix agrees, so the pager is justified.

sections.title: Show your work
sections.body: Storing impact and urgency, not just the priority, means anyone can check the call later. A P1 with no inputs behind it is the one that gets questioned.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A priority assignment the route decision reads to escalate or route.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd rate impact and urgency, look up the priority cell, and note all three so the score can be checked.

tools.powerAutomate: read impact+urgency, look up priority, set the field

takeaway.heading: Priority assigned
points: You derived P1 from high impact and high urgency.
You recorded both inputs, so the priority is auditable.
This ticket is a real P1 - the matrix justifies the page.
The route decision reads this priority next.
The workflow can now assign a defensible priority from the matrix.
